suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention: When consolidating duplicate tests, prefer parameterized test patterns (for loops over assertion arrays/cases) to reduce test count while maintaining coverage. This pattern was used successfully in remote_log.rs, discovery.rs, and http.rs consolidation.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: consolidate-tests feature used parameterized patterns across 3 crates (remote_log.rs:78-119, discovery.rs:1011-1058, http.rs:163-250) reducing 39 escape tests to ~8 and 72 HTTP tests to ~35.
